title: Canonical normalization of ordinary scalar alpha
statement: For any normalized OrdinaryScalarComparison D over a compatible coefficient system, the ordinary strict-tower transformation D.alpha of every commutative proper/quasi-compact-open square equals the canonical towerAlpha, the termwise image of singleAlpha. No cartesian hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Tags 03D7 and 03DI; intrinsic proper/open alpha word, Tag 0F7B

proof.text: Identify cartesian beta by injectivity of its open-adjunction transpose. Identify the clopen-to-direct map as the transpose of the inverse open unit, then cancel its isomorphism to identify pi. Whiskering the unit-normalized open compositor gives the single-level compositor; equality transport is checked by substitution. Substitute these four identities into alpha_eq and use functoriality of whiskering to identify the resulting five-factor word with termwise singleAlpha, which defines towerAlpha. This comparison is made on ordinary systems before localization.

from.place: Proof step 6: identify ordinary alpha with the canonical tower word before localization

lean.statement:
theorem scalarOrdinaryAlphaNormalization (D : OrdinaryScalarComparison R φ B ψ)
    {V W S T : Scheme.{u}} (k : V ⟶ W) (r : V ⟶ S) (p : W ⟶ T) (i : S ⟶ T)
    [IsOpenImmersion k] [IsOpenImmersion i] [QuasiCompact k] [QuasiCompact i]
    [IsProper r] [IsProper p] (h : k ≫ p = r ≫ i) :
    D.alpha k r p i h = StrictTower.towerAlpha B k r p i h
